qualityThreshold.description: The target quality percentage (percentage of empty cells) for board generation. Lower values provide more starting clues, making the level easier.

maxGridSize.description: Restricts the maximum board size options shown in the Level Select screen to control details and cognitive load. Allowed values: 4, 6, 8, 10.

hintsAllowed.description: Controls whether the player is permitted to receive hints from the help button. 1: Hints enabled, 0: Hints disabled.
